extra.text: Wind cannot steal a lantern's flame, but every lantern begins unlit. Craft two unlit lanterns for the lane crew.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Fit the cages cleanly. Oil and flame come only after the vessel is sound.

decline.text: Then leave the glass to steadier hands today. Go safely.

in_progress.text: Two unlit lanterns, newly crafted, will equip the east and west turns.

ready.text: Sound cages and closed panes. They are ready for oil.

extra.text: The crew can fill and light these when dusk calls. Good work begins before the spark.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
